name: Tsuyokiss 2gakki
source: A retelling of Tsuyokiss which takes place a few months after Otome has started living together with Leo (before the game enters any routes) and introduces the transfer student, Celeb, who joined Leo's class.
translation: 本作重新讲述《娇蛮之吻》的故事，时间设定在乙女开始与雷奥同住数月之后、游戏进入任何角色路线之前，并加入了转入雷奥班级的新生赛蕾布。
